title: The Dark Farm
note: b381 — first use of 'barn', 'farm_gate', 'corn', 'fox', 'rock', 'welly_boot'. Page 5's cob-in-mouth detail is simplified to the fox alone (no separate held-cob geometry) — a deliberate omission, not a text/picture conflict.

pages.brief: Wide night view of a farm — barn, gate, corn field — under a deep blue sky. Almost no light yet. Establish the whole setting in one picture.
pages.alt: A wide night view of the whole dark farm: the barn, a farm gate and a field of corn under a deep blue sky with almost no light yet.

pages.brief: Pip small on a gatepost in the foreground, looking up at a large bright full moon. Strong silhouette against a pale moon disc.
pages.alt: Pip stands small on a gatepost, looking up at a large bright full moon that fills much of the sky.

pages.brief: The same moon, drawn tiny at the top of a mostly empty page, with the farm a thin dark strip along the bottom. Use the empty space to say 'far'.
pages.alt: The same moon is drawn tiny at the very top of a mostly empty sky, with the whole farm just a thin dark strip along the bottom of the page.

pages.brief: A fox slipping between corn stalks, low and quick, brush held straight out behind it. Only partly visible through the stems. Sharp and beautiful, not frightening.
pages.alt: A fox slips low and quick between the corn stalks, its brush held straight out behind it, only partly visible through the stems.

pages.brief: The fox trotting away with one corn cob in its mouth, glancing back at the reader with a look of complete innocence. Comic.
pages.alt: The fox trots away with a corn cob held in its mouth, glancing back at the reader with a look of complete innocence.

pages.brief: Ned sitting on a rock pulling off a wellington boot, leaning right back with the effort, tongue out. Very funny physical comedy.
pages.alt: Ned sits on a rock pulling off a wellington boot, leaning right back with the effort, tongue out.

pages.brief: Ned's bare orange foot lowered into a clear cool pool, ripples spreading, his face pure relief. Cool blues against the warm dark.
pages.alt: Ned lowers his bare orange foot into a clear cool pool, ripples spreading outward, his face full of pure relief.

pages.brief: First light: the sky going pale green-gold at the horizon behind the barn, the moon still faintly up. Quiet and hopeful.
pages.alt: First light breaks pale green-gold along the horizon behind the barn, the moon still faintly visible above. Quiet and hopeful.

pages.brief: Closing page: Pip and Ned on the farm gate, sunrise behind them, both facing the new day. Warm gold flooding across the fields.
pages.alt: Pip and Ned sit on the farm gate as the sun rises behind them, warm gold light flooding across the fields.
